people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Horam
people.line: King of Gezer, defeated by Joshua.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.
translations.bsb: At that time Horam king of Gezer went to help Lachish, but Joshua struck him down along with his people, leaving no survivors.
translations.kjv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
translations.asv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
